{{Top|leg}}
'''Togatto Speedway''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] arena located in the tropical [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nurrale]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. Owned by [[Luthus Ferlani]] and his family, it was considered the single most spectacular sporting arena in the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. The arena hosted the [[Annual Jatzday Race]] as well as several other lesser-known events. The track itself was well known for its hairpin turns and torturous spirals.
